Warlock: Age of Entropy

A traditional roguelike by Elephant Door

Warlock: Age of Entropy is a traditional roguelike in which the player embarks on a descent through a treacherous dungeon filled with monsters and undead. The dungeon has an evil lurking in its deepest recess, radiating malice through the labyrinthine halls. A warlock, curious about this evil power, has entered this dungeon to investigate its twisted core. In hopes of wielding greater power, he descends into the heart of the abyss.

The player must use a limited set of spells and scarce resources while fighting (or avoiding) vicious, monstrous enemies. The game primarily is built around the idea of resource management; the player will often find himself low on health, mana, and items. He will need to make decisions about which paths to take, which enemies to fight, how to fight them, and when to descend to the next floor.
